findings.evidence: `rg` shows only the specialized theorem (`TailReverseFiltration.lean:28`) and the generic level equation `revFiltration_apply` (`Martingale/Reverse.lean:69-71`); the proof at `TailReverseFiltration.lean:35-36` is exactly `simpa only [MeasureTheory.revFiltration_apply, tsub_zero] using tailProcess_eq_iInf_tailFamily X`.
findings.fix: Add a general lemma in `TauCeti/Probability/Martingale/Reverse.lean`, e.g. `MeasureTheory.iInf_revFiltration_zero (𝔽) (h_antitone) (h_le) : (⨅ N, (revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N) 0) = ⨅ N, 𝔽 N`, proved by `simp [revFiltration_apply]`, and prove this tail theorem by combining it with `tailProcess_eq_iInf_tailFamily`.
findings.issue: `tailProcess_eq_iInf_revFiltration` is a tail-specific proof of the generic fact `⨅ N, (revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N) 0 = ⨅ N, 𝔽 N`, specialized to `𝔽 = tailFamily X`.

summary: The new API proves only the process-tail instance of a generic reverse-filtration identity. Put the general `revFiltration` infimum-at-zero lemma in the reverse-filtration API, then derive the roadmap-named tail theorem from it.
